initialExam.title: KTET 2026 (Karnataka TET)
initialExam.description: Karnataka Teacher Eligibility Test for qualifying candidates as teachers in Karnataka state government and private schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching qualification as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Paper 1 (Primary): Child Development, Kannada, English, Math, EVS. Paper 2 (High School): Kannada, English, Subject, Child Development.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper 1: 150 marks, 2.5 hrs. Paper 2: 150 marks, 2.5 hrs.
initialExam.jobRole: Primary and High School Teacher in Karnataka
initialExam.careerGrowth: Assistant Teacher → Graduate Teacher → Head Master → BEO → DDPI.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit schooleducation.kar.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee
